title: Mr. India
desc: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.

title: Saudagar
desc: The friendship between Veeru and Rajeshwar turns into a bitter rivalry over time. Years later, they confront each other again when their grandchildren fall in love.

title: Iqbal
desc: Iqbal, a hearing- and speech-impaired boy, dreams of playing for India. When his condition blocks his selection, he turns to a retired coach to train him for his dream.

title: Race 3
desc: While executing their biggest heist, a criminal family uncovers shocking truths that put their relationships and loyalties to the ultimate test.

title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
desc: After a deadly terrorist attack in Uri, Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert operation to eliminate the terrorists responsible, executing a high-risk mission deep across the border.

title: Raid 2
desc: Income Tax officer Amay Patnaik takes on a corrupt nexus in Bhoj, exposing Dada Bhai's sinister empire. As deceit unravels, one question remains-can truth defeat power?

title: Raazi
desc: Sehmat Khan, a brave RAW agent, marries into a Pakistani family at her father's request. Her mission is dangerous-gathering crucial enemy secrets while risking her life.

title: Saaransh
desc: A retired teacher and his wife struggle with grief after losing their only son to a tragic mugging. Slowly, they learn to find peace, holding on to memories and each other.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Baa Baaa Black Sheep
desc: Baba's 25th birthday shocks him as he comes to know that he has to take over his 12 generations old family business of assassination. He falls in love with Angelina, who has secrets of her own.

title: Jai Santoshi Maa
desc: Mahima marries Anuraag and endures hostility from her in-laws. With faith and love, she works to win them over and create a peaceful, happy home together for all.

title: Khalnayak
desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

title: Pardes
desc: Kishorilal chooses Ganga for his NRI son. But Ganga shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son, leading to a conflict between duty and love.

title: Simmba
desc: Simmba, a corrupt cop, works for smuggler Durva. But when Durva's brothers assault a woman, Simmba changes sides and seeks justice, risking everything to make things right.

title: 120 Bahadur
desc: Valiant Indian soldiers fight against Chinese troops during the 1962 Sino-Indian War, preventing a potential occupation of Ladakh region in the Battle of Rezang La.

title: Jawan
desc: A man fueled by a long-held promise sets out to fix the injustices around him, but his mission turns perilous when he confronts a fearless, ruthless outlaw responsible for immense suffering.

title: Vicky Donor
desc: Vicky, a young man, becomes a sperm donor at Dr. Baldev's fertility clinic, leading to humorous and heartwarming events as he navigates unexpected responsibilities.
